title: bug: a project that tracks .serena/project.yml gets W's renamed copy (project_name <name>@<taskId>) as non-DENY dirt, which a worktree checkpoint or completion lands
description: WT-06 (worktree_tooling_node in scripts/moe-agent.sh, twin in .ps1) overwrites W/.serena/project.yml with project_name rewritten to <name>@<taskId>. When the project tracks that file, W's git status shows ` M .serena/project.yml`; denied()/denied_wt only hold UNTRACKED .serena/** (xy '??'), so WT-07 lands the renamed name on moe/task/<id> and the completion carries it to the target. WT-14 effect: such a W is never removed at QA DONE and the orphan sweep rescues the file every time. Found by task-befdddf7 (WT-14); this repo ignores .serena/, so it is unaffected.
definitionOfDone: A W of a project that tracks .serena/project.yml shows no dirt for the WT-06 copy (or the copy is DENY in denied_wt / Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree), and no landing carries a <name>@<taskId> project_name to the task branch or the target; a postflight case covers both wrappers.

implementationPlan.note: Added wtSerenaYml ('wt-serena-yml') after wtCompletion, registered on its own line after the wt-fails line. RED on the unchanged sh wrapper: "[worktree] wt-serena-yml FAILED: AssertionError: the checkpoint carried the WT-06 copy to the task branch" (actual 'project_name: "fixture@task-postflight"\nlanguages: [x]\n', expected the tracked original).

implementationPlan.description:
FIX both twins in parity (epic rail 2), each with the Edit tool. Shared-mode denied() and Test-MoeDenyPath stay unchanged (epic rail 4).

(a) scripts/moe-agent.sh, resolve_attribution's worktree block (about :4518-4526): extend denied_wt's `any(...)` to `pk == pre + '.claude/skills' or pk.startswith(pre + '.claude/skills/') or pk == pre + '.serena/project.yml'`.
(b) scripts/moe-agent.ps1, Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree (about :6261-6273): extend the roots-loop test to `$k -ceq "$dr.claude/skills" -or $k.StartsWith("$dr.claude/skills/") -or $k -ceq "$dr.serena/project.yml"`. Keep the file's UTF-8 BOM; parity-check enforces it.

Update both comments to say why. WT-06 (worktree_tooling_node / its twin) rewrites W/.serena/project.yml at every launch with project_name <name>@<taskId>. denied() holds .serena/** only while it is untracked, so a project that tracks the file would land the renamed name on moe/task/<id>, and the completion would carry it to the target. W's copy is tooling-owned, never task bytes: a deliberate project.yml change cannot ride a worktree landing, because the next launch overwrites it anyway.

The same predicate feeds the control-dirt list, which only drives the diagnostic MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT check, so nothing else changes. Re-run step 1's command: `[worktree] wt-serena-yml ok`.
